game_name: Orwell: Keeping an Eye On You
review_text_raw: Holy cow, never did I ever think I would enjoy a game much like this one. I typically love open world games with lots of story behind it, but this game...Orwell, while it first visually captured me I stayed for the ever feeling of knowing "okay... what happens next?" touch to it. I enjoy that the game makes it as realestic as it possibly can while still keeping that artistic touch to be a hacker-type game. Wish there were more games like this to check out. After playing this for the last three hours I can safely say I would like more of this genre.

game_name: Orwell: Keeping an Eye On You
review_text_raw: Great game, it really felt like choices matter in here. The writing was a little overdone at points, like it was parody of some of these tropey characters, but I was invested enough to still like it. The variety of tools used in the ORWELL system made me feel like a hacker.
